The city's Animal Welfare page lists a Staycation and Daycation Program and links a program document (https://www.cityofmooreok.gov/document/90001941, rev. 11/23/26). Rules were not verified because the PDF could not be retrieved. Shelter at 3500 S. I-35 Service Rd, Moore. Adoption center open Tue-Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-4pm. Phone 405-793-5190.
